text: Nizhny Novgorod Oblast is an oblast (region) in western Russia.
short: Nizhny Novgorod Oblast is a region of Russia

source.name: Government of Nizhny Novgorod Oblast (nobl.ru): Нижегородская область (Nizhny Novgorod Oblast)
source.note: The oblast government's own description of the region (Russian). English: 'Nizhny Novgorod Oblast is one of the largest regions of Russia, part of the Volga Federal District.'
source.quote: Нижегородская область — один из крупнейших регионов России, входит в состав Приволжского федерального округа.

additionalSources.name: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Nizhegorod (archived copy, snapshot 2025-02-14)
additionalSources.note: English. Britannica lists the oblast as 'Also called: Nizhny Novgorod'.
additionalSources.quote: oblast (region) in western Russia, in the middle of the Volga River basin
